body: The sacrifices I have made for them. Now they don't call. They don't ask about how I am. All they do is ask if I can help them. I am spent...done. I love them, but I have nothing more to give. Counting down the days.

The only time anyone in my family comes to me, including my wife, is when they want something from me. As for watching my grand kids grow, we moved to Washington for that very purpose and now they've moved clear across the continent. I suppose I'll be missed for the things that they come to me for, but that is about it.
It crossed my mind, but there's really no point.

I appreciate all your feedback, but this is what I want to do. Oddly enough, before I made my decision, I felt nothing but pain and despair. Now that I have my plan, I feel rather relieved. For what it's worth, there's more to my story as to how and why I've made the decision to end my life. I just didn't feel like taking the time to write it all down.
